name: noesis
description: Noesis is a non-clinical, source-aware self-reflection connector for published or clearly labelled psychometric instruments. It connects to https://noesis.seges.ai/mcp through OAuth authorization code flow with mandatory S256 PKCE. This file is not a claim of listing or host support: a host is supported only after that exact host and version completes a recorded acceptance test.

plugins.name: noesis
plugins.description: Structured, non-clinical self-reflection with published or clearly labelled psychometric instruments and transparent limits. Noesis does not provide therapy, diagnosis, or treatment. Signed-in storage reads require the applicable consent and an explicit per-session source choice; no stored results, profiles, or journal content are loaded by default. Referral results are informational leads only, and users independently verify credentials, availability, scope, and suitability. A host is supported only after its exact version completes a recorded OAuth authorization-code and S256 PKCE acceptance test.
